thread:
jen: Quick sync: proposed a tiny control-plane 'routing shim' to publish compact, versioned routing hints per-tenant. Goal: let edge proxies decide region-affinity locally for common cases without a synchronous control-plane call. Need decisions on API shape, cache semantics, failover rules, and legal residency handling.

ravi: How is shim different from header hints? If proxies lose cache how do they recover?

jen: Shim = small manifest in control plane + streaming reconciler to proxies. Proxies keep TTL'd local copy. On miss, either use heuristic (nearest region) or do a synchronous control-plane lookup depending on tenant mode.

ian: Versioning + ETag conditional fetch sounds good. Add an operator emergency-override path to bypass TTLs.

chris: Interface idea: single header like `X-Rd-Routing: tenant=abc;ver=3;mode=local;residency=eu:hard;pref=eu-west-1,eu-central-1`. `residency=eu:hard` = no cross-region routing unless ops override.

tess: Legal: `hard` residency must keep logs/traces in-region too. We need residency-scope metadata that travels with requests and blocks off-region telemetry.

ravi: Storing per-tenant manifests on every proxy is heavy at scale. Options: compact bloom-ish filter, only store active tenants per shard, or remote fallback pointer. Tradeoffs: latency vs memory.

jen: Proposal: two tenant modes: `local` (cached in proxies — low latency, more memory) and `remote` (proxy does control-plane lookup on miss — less memory). Default `remote` for low-volume tenants; `local` for enterprise/high-QPS.

ian: Failover rules: on full-region degradation, if `residency=soft` allow cross-region failover with audit; if `hard` deny with a clear 451-like response and operator alert. Standardize status code and audit events.

chris: Propose `451-RD-RESIDENCY` with a JSON body explaining allowed regions and denial reason. Emit `residency.override` event when ops force-route.

tess: Tests: simulate eu-west outage. Verify `soft` failover and `hard` blocked. Ensure telemetry and KMS-bound keys remain in-region for `hard`. Need test harness and runbook.

ravi: Telemetry: record manifest version used, decision reason (`local-cache`|`remote-lookup`|`fallback-nearest`), and outcome (`routed`|`blocked`|`failed-over`). Sample high-volume tenants; full logs for enterprise.

jen: Rough API sketch: `GET /v1/tenants/{id}/routing-hint` returns `mode`, `residency`, `prefer_regions`, `version`. Proxies use `version` to short-circuit fetches.

ian: Add ACLs for who can set `hard` residency and an approvals flow. Retain old versions for audit, GC after retention window.

ops-bot: deploy: region-routing-shim v1 canary -> eu-west-1 scheduled 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC :rocket:

tess: Add legal checklist and KMS location enforcement for `hard`. Also audit operator overrides >5m.

ravi: Optimization: wildcard rules for orgs to reduce per-tenant storage. Could cover many tenants with one rule.

jen: Migration path: start default `remote`, enable `local` for small high-volume set, measure memory and P99, auto-promote by QPS/SLA heuristic.

chris: Include RFC appendix for lifecycle: create -> update (version bump) -> override -> revoke -> GC; include operator safety gates for `hard`.

jen: Action items: I'll draft RFC with API proto, reconcilers, canary plan, and test matrix (eu outage, trace locality). Please review by EOD tomorrow.

ian: +1 on scope; I'll add ETag/streaming details.

ravi: +1; will prototype wildcard rules and memory calc.

tess: +1 with legal checklist for `hard`.

chris: +1; I'll draft status-code and audit-event schemas.

jen: Thanks everyone. We'll track RFC comments in the doc and sync next week.
